description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain activation resiliency, specifically testing recovery from invalid or 'poison' grain directory entries, including scenarios of local and remote silo recovery.

classes.name: GrainLocatorActivationResiliencyTests
classes.description: A test class verifying Orleans' ability to recover from invalid grain directory entries, including local and remote silo scenarios.

methods.name: ReactivateGrainWithPoisonGrainDirectoryEntry_LocalSilo
methods.description: Tests the ability of a silo to recover from a poison directory entry pointing to a non-existent activation on the same silo.

methods.name: ReactivateGrainWithPoisonGrainDirectoryEntry_RemoteSilo
methods.description: Tests the recovery process when a secondary silo encounters a poison directory entry pointing to the primary silo, ensuring proper forwarding and recovery.
